newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Experts to assess damage at Harties mine.
newsitem.headline: Experts to assess damage at Harties mine.

text.p: A team of technical experts will go down the Hartebeestfontein gold mine on Thursday to assess structural damage following a fatal rockburst in the No 4 A shaft earlier this week, a company spokesman said.
The confirmed death toll at the mine, owned by South African mining house Avgold Ltd, is 15 and a further three miners are still missing presumed dead.

Most gold mining at the shaft, which accounts for around 20 percent of mine production, remains halted. However, some limited blasting is taking place in areas far away from the rockburst which occurred about 2,170 metres underground. The technical team will try to ascertain when it would be safe to recommence more widespread blasting.
Hartebeestfontein produced 5.3 tonnes of gold in the first quarter of this year.
